_about: The benchmark's pictures and how deep each is run (owner, 23 Nov: "core is 1 photo per group"; "extended is all 15"). Read by the runners: `npm run paint -- core|extended ...` (Auto and levels 2 to 4) and `node bench/scripts/run.mjs --round V3 --crops core|extended` (level 1), through tools/paint/run-sets.mjs; `node tools/paint/run-sets.mjs core` lists every painting a set asks for and starts nothing. id: the subject's id in the registry (SUBJECTS.json). group: the kind of picture; the core has one of each. levelOne: the picture's level 1 target in bench/v3/crops.json (made by bench/scripts/add-level-one-target.mjs on the standard sheet), or null while none is made; a target without its rendering unit is refused by the level 1 runner.

full.what: the whole ladder: levels 1 to 4, and Auto, which every score is measured against

core.what: five pictures, one of each group, on the whole ladder

extended.what: all fifteen: the core five on the whole ladder, the other ten at Auto and level 2

pictures.title: Manet, Morisot with a Fan (the approved crop)
